cases.candidate_name: DCB Innovation Challenge 2023: Meet This Year’s Mentors!

claim.text: The candidate is a project linked to DCB Innovation Challenge 2023, hosted by Diabetes Center Berne. Mentors include Michael Schoemaker, a Medical Devices Industry Expert with 20+ years experience in CGM device development covering clinical studies and launch activities, and Stefanie Hofer, a Clinical Research Physician with expertise in clinical validation of machine-learning algorithms. The project provides a route for external companies to discuss collaboration with DCB, a centre for diabetes technology in Bern.
